item.tib: sku gsum rig 'dus dran pa drag phur dam sri kun sgrol gnam lcags dbal 'khor gsang ba dgongs 'dus las bdud rtsi sman gta' dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter 'khyil
item.coloph: ces sman gta' 'di nyid shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i gnas kyi byang nub phur pa'i bsgrub gnas gsang ba yongs rdzongs gsang phug shel gur 'bar ba'i gnas nas bla chen yab sras rig 'dzin tshogs gral nas/ 'od ldan 'bar ma'i (mas) lung ston cing gsang phur brda yi dbang bskur snyan brgyud (rgyud) zab mo nyag sprul tshe dbang 'gyur med dam/ rig rtsal gling pa bdag la gnang bzhin/ khro chen rgyal sras nang so tshe dbang nor 'dzin dang / rig (rigs) ldan las rgya gter gyi lde mig pad+ma dbang mo'i (mos) rten 'brel 'byed pa'i brdas bskul ba dang*/ bka' bab las slob du ma'i (mas) bskul bzhin khro chen bla brang gzim khang nang dbyings rig mdzod khrid kyis (kyi) thun mtshoms (mtshams) su lcags mo sbrul lo zla 8 tshes 10 nyid dgongs pa'i brda bkrol grub pas/ dge'o//
